logout.title: Log out

resetDone.alertTitle: We have emailed you instructions for setting your password.

resetConfirm.invalidTitle: This link is no longer valid

resetConfirm.title: Choose a new password
resetConfirm.subtitle: Pick something you have not used anywhere else.
resetConfirm.failed: Your password could not be set.

resetComplete.title: Password set
resetComplete.subtitle: You can log in with it now.
resetComplete.footer: New here after all? <link>Create an account</link>

passwordChange.title: Change your password
passwordChange.subtitle: You will stay signed in here and be signed out everywhere else.

passwordChange.failed: Your password could not be changed.

passwordChangeDone.title: Password changed

passwordChangeDone.footer: Somewhere to be? <link>Back to the problems</link>

emailChange.privacyTitle: Your address is only ever used for the judge.
emailChange.privacyDescription: Activation, password resets and the gravatar on your profile. Nothing else.
emailChange.sameAddress: That is already your email address.
emailChange.requestedDescription: Follow the link we sent to {email} to finish the change. We have also told {current} that somebody asked.
emailChange.nothingArrives: Nothing arrives? Check the spam folder, then <link>try again</link>.
emailChange.newHint: We send the confirmation link here.
emailChange.passwordHint: Confirm it is you before we move the account.
emailChange.reauth: Log in again to change your email.
emailChange.tooMany: You have asked for too many changes. Wait a minute and try again.
emailChange.addressUnusable: That address could not be used.

emailChangeActivate.failedSubtitle: Nothing has changed on your account.
emailChangeActivate.failedAlertTitle: This link is no longer valid.
emailChangeActivate.failedAlertDescription: It may have expired, been used already, or the address may have been taken by somebody else in the meantime. Open the link while logged in to the account that asked for the change.
emailChangeActivate.doneSubtitle: Your account now uses the new address.
emailChangeActivate.doneAlert: The email attached to your account has been changed.

twoFactor.staffRequired: Staff accounts must keep two factor authentication enabled.

overview.title: Two factor authentication
overview.requiredTitle: Set up two factor authentication to carry on.
overview.requiredDescription: Staff accounts need a second factor. Enrol one and you will be taken back to where you were.
overview.totpDescription: A six digit code from an app on your phone, on top of your password. Codes are accepted with one period of tolerance either side, so a slightly wrong clock still works.
overview.turnOffLocked: Staff accounts must keep at least one second factor. Register a passkey first.
overview.scratchDescription: Single-use codes that stand in for your app when you do not have your phone. Generating a new set replaces the old one.
overview.scratchDescriptionOff: Scratch codes are issued when you set up an authenticator app.
overview.scratchLeft: {count, plural, =0 {You have no scratch codes left.} one {You have one scratch code left.} other {You have # scratch codes left.}}
overview.passkeysDescription: Touch ID, Windows Hello, a hardware key or your phone. A passkey signs you in on its own and counts as a second factor.
overview.staffRequiredDescription: You can swap one factor for another, but the last one cannot be removed.

enable.footer: Changed your mind? <link>Back to two factor authentication</link>
enable.setupFailed: Two factor authentication could not be set up. Try again.
enable.wrongCode: That code is not right. Wait for the next one and try again.
enable.scanSubtitle: Add it to your authenticator app, then type the code it shows.
enable.scanFooter: No camera? Type the key above into your app by hand instead.
enable.codeHint: Six digits. The boxes advance as you type and submit on the last one.
enable.doneSubtitle: Save these scratch codes before you go.
enable.doneFooter: You can generate a new set any time from <link>two factor authentication</link>.

disable.title: Turn off two factor authentication
disable.subtitle: Prove it is you before your account drops back to a password alone.
disable.footer: Changed your mind? <link>Back to two factor authentication</link>
disable.blockedDescription: Register a passkey first if you want to stop using an authenticator app. <link>Register a passkey</link>
disable.wrongCode: That code is not right, or it has already been used.
disable.failed: Two factor authentication could not be turned off. Check your password.
disable.codeHint: Six digits from your app, or one of your scratch codes.

scratch.failed: Those codes could not be generated.
scratch.doneSubtitle: The old set no longer works.
scratch.title: New scratch codes
scratch.subtitle: {count, plural, one {You have one code left. A new set replaces it.} other {You have # codes left. A new set replaces them.}}
scratch.footer: Changed your mind? <link>Back to two factor authentication</link>
scratch.passwordHint: Confirm it is you before we reissue them.
scratch.reauth: Log in again to generate scratch codes.
scratch.rejected: That password is not right, or two factor authentication is not on.

challenge.title: Two factor authentication
challenge.scratchSubtitle: Enter one of the scratch codes you saved.
challenge.totpSubtitle: Enter the six digit code from your authenticator app.
challenge.footer: Lost your phone and your codes? <link>Open a ticket</link> and a staff member can help.
challenge.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and start again.
challenge.wrongCode: That code is not right. Wait for the next one and try again.
challenge.wrongScratchCode: That scratch code is not right, or it has already been used.
challenge.codeHint: Six digits from your authenticator app. The boxes advance as you type.

passkeys.assertSubtitle: Your browser will ask for your fingerprint, face or security key.
passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.registerFailed: That passkey could not be registered. Try again.
passkeys.removeFailed: That passkey could not be removed.
passkeys.nameHint: Something you will recognise later, like “work laptop” or “YubiKey”.
passkeys.unsupported: This browser does not support passkeys.
passkeys.emptyDescription: Register one above and you can sign in with your fingerprint, face or hardware key.
passkeys.removeLocked: Staff accounts must keep at least one second factor.
passkeys.confirmRemoveDescription: That device will no longer sign you in. You can register it again later.
passkeys.staffRequiredDescription: Your last remaining factor cannot be removed.

apiToken.title: API token
apiToken.bearerTitle: Send it as a bearer token.
apiToken.bearerNote: A token never has more access than its owner does.
apiToken.scopeRead: Read the API v2 endpoints, limited to what you can already see.
apiToken.scopeProblemsWrite: Create and update problems through the problems API. What a problem repository's CI needs.
apiToken.revokeFailed: That token could not be revoked.
apiToken.copyNowDescription: Only a hash is kept, so this is the one time it is shown. A lost token is replaced, not recovered.
apiToken.nameHint: What it is for, so you know which one to revoke later.
apiToken.emptyDescription: Generate one above to call the API from a script or a problem repository.
apiToken.legacyDescription: An API token imported from DMOJ is still valid on this account. Revoke it once your scripts use a token from above.
apiToken.legacyDescriptionWithHint: An API token imported from DMOJ is still valid on this account ({hint}). Revoke it once your scripts use a token from above.
apiToken.confirmRevokeDescription: Anything using it stops working straight away. This cannot be undone.
apiToken.confirmRevokeLegacyTitle: Revoke the token from the old site?
apiToken.confirmRevokeLegacyDescription: Any script still using the DMOJ token stops working straight away.
apiToken.reauth: Log in again to generate a token.
apiToken.createFailed: That token could not be created.
